Specification: This module specifies a PlusCal algorithm named EvenOdd that determines whether a natural number N is even or odd by mutual recursion between procedures Even and Odd. The translated TLA+ model represents procedure calls explicitly with a program counter pc, a stack of activation records, procedure-local variables xEven and xOdd, and a boolean result variable, and it allows infinite stuttering after reaching termination to avoid deadlock. The specification defines the initial state, the step relation for each control location, a temporal specification with weak fairness on Next, and an eventual termination property asserting that execution eventually reaches pc = "Done".
IfThenElse: IF xEven = 0 THEN /\ result' = TRUE /\ pc' = Head(stack).pc /\ xEven' = Head(stack).xEven /\ stack' = Tail(stack) /\ xOdd' = xOdd ELSE /\ /\ stack' = << [ procedure |->  "Odd", pc        |->  Head(stack).pc, xOdd      |->  xOdd ] >> \o Tail(stack) /\ xOdd' = xEven - 1 /\ pc' = "Odd1" /\ UNCHANGED << result, xEven >>

IF xOdd = 0 THEN /\ result' = FALSE /\ pc' = "Odd2" /\ UNCHANGED << stack, xEven >> ELSE /\ /\ stack' = << [ procedure |->  "Even", pc        |->  "Odd2", xEven     |->  xEven ] >> \o stack /\ xEven' = xOdd - 1 /\ pc' = "Even1" /\ UNCHANGED result
